adjudicator: Codex manual source/rationale review; not independent CTO acceptance
limits: Repeated synthetic controls are not real-repository precision.
Only final findings are classified here; withheld decisions remain in the retained source reports.
Deterministic boundary detections are counted separately from model detections.
A detected defect in a partial run does not complete its required assessment.
Prompt and model roles changed from v4; this is not an isolated causal comparison.
A no-finding result is accepted only with completed required model checks.
